explanation: Three-judge panel overruled Caldwell's per se prejudice holding, but expressly because it is clearly irreconcilable with the intervening Supreme Court decision in Neder, invoking Miller v. Gammie; limb 3 fails.
Panel opinion expressly overruled Atari, Loctite and Cygnus on choice of circuit law, but footnote states that section was considered and decided unanimously by the in banc court; limbs 2 and 3 fail.

Second District panel receded from O'Brien and Solis, but grounded this on conflict with the earlier Florida Supreme Court decision in Bell; also, from my knowledge, Florida DCAs had no en banc procedure until 1980; limbs 3 and 4 fail.
Louisiana First Circuit overruled Harris and Miceli to the extent of conflict, but the judges line lists thirteen judges with multiple concurrences and dissents, an en banc sitting; limb 2 fails.

Panel overruled Jobin and Fidelity Savings on the standard of review, but the footnote states the opinion was circulated to all unrecused active judges and all agreed; full-court approval means limb 3 fails.
Panel abrogated Hall's uniform remand rule in Anders cases, but acknowledged the prior-panel rule and stated the opinion was circulated to all active members of the court; limb 3 fails.

Commonwealth Court sat as seven judges including the President Judge, an en banc bench, when departing from Ehman (overruling passage omitted from excerpt; relying on my knowledge and the dissent); limb 2 fails.
